thread:
Nora: Quick consistency note from the deprecation sweep: some pages use 'Deprecated: will be removed in v2', others use 'This field is deprecated', and a few have no clear migration guidance. We should pick a single deprecation voice and a canonical callout style.
Ben: Agreed. Proposal: use a short H3 'Deprecated' callout followed by a single sentence migration pattern: 'Deprecated: use <new-feature> instead.' Keep specific removal timelines in parens if necessary.
Carlos: Sounds good. For snippets we should show a before/after migration example so users can update code quickly. Eg:
```
# before
client.setModelAlias('old', 'redwood-1')

# after
client.set-alias({ 'alias-name': 'old', 'model-id': 'redwood-1' })
```
Mei: I'll add a tiny linter rule to flag ambiguous phrases like 'will be removed soon' or 'deprecated without guidance'. Regex idea: grep -R "will be removed|deprecated without" docs/ and surface matches in CI.
Nora: Also let's standardize the microcopy: use 'Deprecated' as the callout title, and in the sentence use plain present-tense 'use' rather than 'please use' to keep it direct. Example: 'Deprecated: use `model-id` instead.'
Ben: Nice. I'll add a one-line style guide entry under /docs/style.md: 'Deprecations: use a callout titled "Deprecated" with a one-line migration suggestion; include a code before/after example when applicable.'
Carlos: I'll sweep the SDK snippets I own and add migration snippets where missing. I'll also update any camelCase params (e.g., aliasId -> alias-id) in code blocks.
DocsBot: automated note: docs-linter found 8 docs pages with inconsistent deprecation wording. See report: /internal/reports/deprecation-scan-2026-03-23.
Mei: After Ben lands the style blurb I'll open a CI PR with the grep rule and a docsbot message to the PR template reminding authors to add migration examples for deprecated items.
Nora: Can we also add aliases in the glossary for deprecated names so search still works? e.g., 'old-alias' -> aliases: 'aliasId', 'setModelAlias'.
Ben: Good idea. I'll include a short note in the glossary PR and mark those entries as 'deprecated aliases' so we can surface them in search results.
Carlos: Plan: (1) Ben adds style blurb + glossary alias note, (2) Mei adds CI grep and PR template reminder, (3) Carlos patches snippets with before/after examples, (4) Nora coordinates review and merges. Aim to clear the linter flags today.
Mei: I'll start the CI PR now and tag reviewers.
DocsBot: queued job: docs-deprecation-recheck (post-merge scan).
Nora: Thanks all 44d. Small changes but high signal for users.
Ben: I'll draft the style blurb and push in ~30m.
Carlos: Updating snippets now; will comment on affected PRs.
Mei: CI PR open: #3667.
DocsBot: reminder: include changelog notes if public snippet URLs change.
